The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Installation at Own Cost: The successful bidder shall supply, transport, unload, assemble and install a ll the supplied gym equipment at Gram Panchayat Sitanagar, at their own cost. No additional charges shall be payable by the Gram Panchayat for transportation, labour, installation or commissioning.

Shop Registration Certificate: The bidder shall submit a valid Shop and Establishment Registration C ertificate or other applicable business registration certificate issued by the competent authority in the And aman & Nicobar Islands along with the bid. 4. Quality of Equipment: All gym equipment supplied must be brand new, unused and of good quality, c onforming to the specifications mentioned in the bid. 6. Warranty: The bidder shall provide a manufacturer's warranty for the supplied gym equipment as speci fied in the bid. 7. Inspection and Acceptance: Payment shall be released only after satisfactory supply, installation, ins pection and acceptance of the equipment by the competent authority of Gram Panchayat Sitanagar. 8. Completion of Work: The successful bidder shall complete the supply and installation within the stipul ated period mentioned in the work order. 9. Responsibility for Damage: The bidder shall be responsible for any damage caused to the Building or its premises during transportation, unloading, installation or commissioning. 10. Right to Reject: The Gram Panchayat reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids without assigning any reason, as per applicable procurement rules. .
